newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel in partnership with Ascend.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel in partnership with Ascend.

text.p: Alcatel Telecom said in a statement it had signed a product partnership with Ascend Communications under which it would integrate Ascend's Internet connection products and services in its product portfolio.

"Due to this agreement, the two companies will be able to offer to telecommunication operators over the whole world solutions that will simplify the access to Internet and wide-band networks, for all sophisticated applications of the net, combining voice, data and video," Alcatel said.
Alcatel Telecom is a unit of Alcatel Alsthom.
